s: Ryotwari system was first introduced in the Madras Presidency in
x:
The Ryotwari System was first experimentally introduced in the Baramahal region by Alexander Read and was later developed and expanded by Sir Thomas Munro. Under this system, the government collected land revenue directly from the cultivator (Ryot), eliminating intermediaries such as Zamindars.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

Palegars in Rayalaseema were suppressed by whom?
x:
Sir Thomas Munro suppressed the Palegars (Poligars) of Rayalaseema during the early nineteenth century. After restoring law and order, he introduced the Ryotwari System, under which the government collected land revenue directly from cultivators. His administrative reforms had a lasting impact on the revenue system of the Madras Presidency.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
